reviews.text: I brought in my new kitten for a wellness check and they were so sweet and gentle with her. Made me feel really comfortable bringing in my furchild here and establishing her care.

've been taking my Rat Terrier, Mattie, to PCAC since I got her in 2008 when she was 11 weeks old. Sh'll be 18 years old next month. The staff and clinic are the best. I would never consider taking her anywhere else!

Love love love this place! The staff was so awesome from the front desk all the way through the entire experience! They are worth every penny. Veterinarians are not cheap anyplace you go but when you experience the kind of love a place has for their clients, you know your money is spent well and your pet is cared for.  That's worth it.

Not very thorough with exams. Very rushed. Very impersonal and somewhat rude. Trying to find a nice vet with a good bedside manner while also being knowledgeable and thorough.  This is not it.  Definitely not going back.
Great office and great staff!!!
Justin, we appreciate the perfect rating! It's wonderful to know you enjoyed your visit. We hope to welcome you and your pet back to our clinic in the future.
Thanks for the top rating! We're happy to know you enjoyed your experience. Looking forward to your next visit!

I would like to share my deeply positive experience with Preston Center Animal Clinic.
A year ago, just a few days before a planned vacation, my cat suddenly started falling on her side. The animal clinic team fit us in immediately for an unexpected sick visit. Dr. Montgomery took the time to run tests, explained everything clearly, and suggested a treatment plan that worked perfectly.
Recently, I brought in another cat for a checkup, and once again, the team of Preston Center Animal Clinic showed incredible kindness and attentiveness. Appointments always run on time, and the front desk staff is exceptionally friendly.
Outstanding service from start to finish!
We’re grateful for your 5-star review, Lindsay! It's fantastic to know you had a positive experience. We look forward to your next visit!
Service is always professional and friendly. They take great care of our dog!

Drs. Mueller and Montgomery are providing exceptional elderly dog care and ALWAYS go above and beyond for my 16 year old Schnauzer/poodle mix, Duke!!  Lara, Jennifer, Mahriah, and Ally always treat Duke like he is loved and valued!
Lovely, attentive, knowledgeable, and responsive vets and staff.  Online scheduling and pet care reminders are a huge plus!
Great Vet! They treat you and your pet like family
Competent and efficient got my USDA EU Pet Health Certificate within 2 days of the visit and it is on its way by Fedex 5 days after the exam.
Been taking my pets to Preston Center Animal Clinic for 25 years. The best.
I have three dogs. So I use the clinic quite a bit. The doctors and staff could not be more helpful. I love everything about Preston Center Animal Clinic.
We love PCAC! We come here for all our fosters and both our own pets. They are responsive, proactive, and take great care of our pets!
I have been with Preston Center Animal Clinic for over 30 years.  Awesome practice. Highly recommend.
Nice people with experience folks
Preston Center Animal Clinic has been our family veterinarian for nearly forty years. They're  wonderful.
Thank you so much, Jennifer, for your wonderful 5-star rating!

PCAC is amazing! Great vets, great support staff. My family has been taking our dogs here for over 20 years, and I’d never consider going elsewhere. Special shoutouts to Lara for keeping things running smoothly and to Aly for always going above and beyond.
We love the good people at PCAC.  They have cared for every single pet we have had for 25+ years.  They are excellent with their craft and we love them dearly for excelling at their job.
Was able to be seen same-day for a sick visit. Staff and the veterinarian were both kind and patient. Doggo is doing much better!

This is one of the best vet Clinics I’ve ever been to.  I never thought I could find another vet as good as Terry Ford but this office comes close.  Very caring & thorough.  They know exactly what to do for Daisys allergies!  And as a plus it’s mostly women which I like.  Very fortunate to have found this clinic.   Highly recommend.
Friendly and professional and so loving
I couldn't recommend better vets and staff! My dog went from hospice care monitoring to recovery and heart worm treatment here, and we loved every person we met. Very thankful for their service!!!

Hi Trish, thank you for the great review! Our entire team works very hard to make sure that we are offering the best experience. We appreciate you and look forward to seeing you and your pet next time!

We’ve been using Preston Center Animal Clinic since 1977 and have always been delighted with the care they provide to our dogs, the third of which is now 15 thanks to their loving care. Besides the veterinarians being highly competent and compassionate, their staff are wonderful. We would recommend this practice to everyone.
We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a positive rating. Thank you for choosing us, Janie!
Thank you, Cathy, for your 5-star rating! We truly value your support and your trust means a lot to us.
Awesome place and staff. They got my fur baby right together and even helped me with a phone charger when my battery died!!! DEFINITIVELY 5🌟!!!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We truly value your support!
The staff and doctors are very friendly and very caring.

We have an English Bulldog who has severe anxiety and needs special care. They were so caring and loaded him up with treats and made him feel comfortable. The tech, Chelsi was so kind and patient and Dr. Mueller was so attentive and sweet.

I’m really happy with my experience so far. During my first visit, they were able to confirm with x rays an asthma diagnosis I’d long suspected but that had been ignored by a previous vet. Their front office staff is great, it’s easy to get appointments, and their online pharmacy has been a god send. Highly recommend!
Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your feedback and are delighted to hear that you had a positive experience with us.

Drove an hour just to see Dr. Chuang for my pug’s annual checkup — totally worth it! She’s super friendly, took her time with all the important tests, and explained everything clearly. I felt so comfortable leaving my pug in her care!

This place is absolutely amazing! All the staff members are 100% kind welcoming and knowledgeable it's clean well kept and decorated nicely they really helped me and my foster kittens with getting them the proper meds and medical advice etc they we're so loving with them and kind to me as well above and beyond service

I brought our foster pup Sam III here, and I can’t say enough good things! The staff was beyond amazing—so kind, so patient, and so understanding. They absolutely spoiled Sam with treats and love, which meant the world because he’s a very anxious boy due to his past experiences. They took the time to make him comfortable and really showed how much they care.
If you have a pet who’s nervous around new people or the vet, this is the place to go. I couldn’t recommend them more! 🐾❤️
Great service and very thorough. Very helpful vets and very patient and sweet with our cat. I would definitely recommend. Good prices too.

PCAC is absolutely WONDERFU!. Everyone is incredibly knowledgeable, compassionate, and devoted to pets and their parents. Dr. Chuang is our preferred vet, who provides outstanding care for our 12-yo Scottie. Support staff, including Lara, Chelsi, Aly, and Paola, is superb! Paws down the BEST!
I brought a foster dog i was taking care of for her wellness check, and we were in and out quick and they were very sweet to her

Preston Center is truly the best place you can bring your pets! Everyone here is absolutely wonderful. Dr. Chuang is especially kind, very easy to talk to, and takes such good care of your pet. I found her a few years ago at another clinic in Dallas and was so sad she had left, then realized she moved here! All of the technicians here are also amazing. A few days ago, my dog, Ellie, had surgery and Jennifer was so kind to answer questions while the surgery was ongoing and afterwards. She walked me through my dog’s entire procedure and the tests/x-rays they performed. The rest of the staff is just as amazing, especially Lara and Aly. After Ellie’s procedure, she was a little nauseous and I had some follow up questions. Lara and Aly immediately responded and were so caring. I also heard back from the doctor very quickly afterwards. Everyone at this office truly treats your pet as their own. I have had a very hard time finding a great veterinarian in Dallas and am so happy to have found Preston Center. Thank you everyone here for being so incredible. I hardly ever write reviews, but I am just so thankful to have received such wonderful care here the last week and truly cannot recommend this place enough.
Hello Tia, we appreciate your 5-star rating! It's wonderful to hear that you had a great experience.
Great service!
Been taking our pets here my whole life! 🐱 🐶 ❤️ …
Our foster kittens always get the best care here!
Thank you so much for sharing your feedback, Jorge! We are truly grateful for your kind 5-star rating!
Thank you for the 5 star review, Kate! Your feedback is appreciated and we're here to help you and Rue whenever you need us in the future.
